boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Quinnipiac University
boards.description: Current late-hours food options on campus and in Hamden, selected from direct university and business sources.

cards.title: Outtakes
cards.subtitle: North Haven Campus
cards.notes: Use the North Haven Campus convenience store when you need a snack or grab-and-go item outside standard dining service.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac identifies Outtakes on the North Haven Campus as a 24-hour convenience store with grab-and-go meals and snacks.
cards.access_notes: University dining page describes Outtakes as a 24-hour convenience store; confirm campus access requirements before traveling.

cards.title: Tonino's Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 3450 Whitney Avenue, Hamden
cards.notes: Place a pickup or delivery order from this Whitney Avenue pizzeria; its own site specifically notes delivery to Quinnipiac University.
cards.short_summary: Pizza delivery close to the Mount Carmel area until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Tonino's states it is open daily from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. and delivers to Quinnipiac University.
cards.access_notes: Open seven days, 11 a.m.–10 p.m., according to the business website.

cards.title: Three Brothers Diner
cards.subtitle: 1038 Dixwell Avenue, Hamden
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, takeout, or delivery from the diner’s all-day breakfast, lunch, dinner, and pizza menu before its listed close.
cards.short_summary: A Hamden diner with midnight daily service.
cards.evidence_claim: Three Brothers Diner lists daily dine-in hours of 6 a.m. to midnight and delivery through 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open seven days, 6 a.m.–midnight; delivery is listed 8 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: Kumo Japanese Cuisine
cards.subtitle: 218 Skiff Street, Hamden
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday dinner here when you want a later listed closing time than the restaurant’s weekday schedule.
cards.short_summary: Japanese-cuisine option listed until 11 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Kumo lists dinner hours through 11 p.m. on Friday and Saturday at its Skiff Street location.
cards.access_notes: Dinner is listed until 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Legend Pizza
cards.subtitle: 1500 Dixwell Avenue, Hamden
cards.notes: Use the direct ordering site to check the current menu and place a pickup or delivery order before the listed 10 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A Dixwell Avenue pizza option listed to 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Legend Pizza’s ordering page lists its Hamden location at 1500 Dixwell Avenue with hours of 11 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The business ordering page lists hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m.; check the live ordering status before leaving.

cards.title: Pizza Choice
cards.subtitle: 1216 Dixwell Avenue, Hamden
cards.notes: Order ahead for pickup or delivery from this Dixwell Avenue restaurant, which lists pizza alongside sandwiches, salads, and breakfast.
cards.short_summary: A broad-menu pizza stop listed through 9:45 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Choice lists its 1216 Dixwell Avenue location and current ordering hours of 11 a.m. to 9:45 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Listed ordering hours are 11 a.m.–9:45 p.m.; confirm availability in the ordering page.

cards.title: Genki Japanese Cuisine
cards.subtitle: 2300 Dixwell Avenue, Suite 22, Hamden
cards.notes: Schedule a Saturday meal at this Dixwell Avenue restaurant when its published hours extend later than its weekday and Sunday close.
cards.short_summary: Japanese cuisine with a 10:30 p.m. Saturday closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Genki lists Saturday hours of 11 a.m. to 10:30 p.m. at 2300 Dixwell Avenue, Suite 22.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are listed until 10 p.m. Monday–Friday and 10:30 p.m. Saturday; Sunday closes at 9:30 p.m.

cards.title: Hamden Town House Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 2260 Whitney Avenue, Hamden
cards.notes: Use the diner’s published daily hours for a sit-down meal; breakfast is listed as available throughout the day and night.
cards.short_summary: A Whitney Avenue diner that lists midnight daily closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamden Town House Restaurant states it is open from 6 a.m. to midnight, seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s site lists daily hours of 6 a.m.–midnight and notes that it closes on Christmas Day.

cards.title: McDonald's at 1260 Dixwell Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1260 Dixwell Avenue, Hamden
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru option for the latest listed service window; lobby hours end earlier than drive-thru hours every day.
cards.short_summary: Drive-thru service listed through 1–2 a.m., depending on day.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists drive-thru hours at 1260 Dixwell Avenue through 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Lobby hours are listed to 11 p.m. daily; drive-thru is listed to 1 a.m. Sun–Thu and 2 a.m. Fri–Sat.

cards.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill
cards.subtitle: 2165 Dixwell Avenue, Hamden
cards.notes: Order a burrito, bowl, quesadilla, taco, or salad for pickup or delivery before the restaurant’s published nightly closing time.
cards.short_summary: A national fast-casual option with 11 p.m. daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle lists its 2165 Dixwell Avenue Hamden restaurant open daily from 10:45 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are listed as 10:45 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
